title: 第一卷 第12章 附属木屋
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

红发青年舔了舔自己的嘴唇，随即去收集那些爆出来的物品。

而在旁边，还有一个木屋，此时木屋的主人，一个衣着清凉的女人。

此时已经完全没有了呼吸，那白皙的大长腿，根本没有让红毛，怜惜一份！

“女人，只会影响我升级的步伐，想不到这女人的天赋能够在体内凝聚出暗器。”

“现在，这个能力是我的了，用来杀丧尸，还真的不错......”

红发男子随后又看向了女子白皙的长腿，不过眼中并不是男人都懂的眼神，更像是一种食欲！

秦龙看了一会就继续收集石头，耳边却听到了一些不一样的声音。

那声音，似乎比较远，像是一个女人在惊呼，还有丧尸的怒吼声！

“这周围，有别的求生者？”

秦龙心中一愣，不是说每个人都是专属的一条路吗？

说是能够偶尔相交，但这只是第二天，这么快吗？

顺着声音，秦龙朝着那个方向看去。

那边也是草地，不过那边似乎有一片地方是凹下去的。

声音就是从那个地方传来的。

“要不要去看看？”

秦龙暗自想到。

看了看周围，依旧是没有丧尸！

既然这样，就摸过去看看。

那边有丧尸嘶吼的声音。

自己的大威力左轮手枪，已经跃跃欲试了！

杀丧尸，才是这个世界最好的资源来源。

不仅仅会爆一些物资，最主要的是爆寿元啊！

寿元这个东西，不仅可以在寿元商城里面买那些好东西。

对于自己来说，还是移植金色铭刻特性的必需品！

脚下速度飞快，声音逐渐清晰。

不过总感觉有点不对劲，感觉自己比之前的速度快了很多！

此时已经能够听到女人的爆喝声和丧尸战斗的声音。

这个女人，还不错，能够坚持到现在。

丧尸的数量应该不少，这实力，不容小觑！

等到了那个凹下去的边缘，秦龙脚步放慢，缓缓地凑了上去。

视线之中，终于看到了声音的来源。

秦龙吸了一口冷气。

场面有点吓人。

自己料想之中的丧尸也就是几只。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The red-haired young man licked his lips and then went to collect the items that exploded.

Next to it, there is a wooden house, and the owner of the wooden house is a woman in cool clothes.

At this time, he was completely out of breath, and those long white legs did not let Hong Mao show any mercy at all!

"A woman will only affect the pace of my upgrade. I didn't expect that this woman's talent can condense a hidden weapon in her body."

"Now, this ability is mine. It's really good for killing zombies..."

The red-haired man then looked at the woman's long fair legs, but the look in his eyes was not a look that all men would understand, it was more like a look of appetite!

Qin Long watched for a while and then continued to collect stones, but heard some different sounds in his ears.

The voice seemed far away, like a woman exclaiming, and the roar of zombies!

"Are there any other survivors around here?"

Qin Long was stunned. Didn't it mean that everyone has his own path?

It is said that they can intersect occasionally, but it is only the second day, is it so fast?

Following the sound, Qin Long looked in that direction.

There is also grass over there, but there seems to be a sunken area there.

That's where the sound came from.

"Would you like to go take a look?"

Qin Long thought to himself.

I looked around, but there were still no zombies!

In this case, let's touch it and take a look.

There are zombies roaring over there.

I'm already ready to try my powerful revolver!

Killing zombies is the best source of resources in this world.

Not only will it explode some supplies, but the most important thing is to explode longevity!

With Shouyuan, you can not only buy good things in Shouyuan Mall.

For myself, it is still necessary to transplant the golden engraving characteristics!

The speed of his feet was fast, and his voice gradually became clearer.

But something felt wrong, I felt like I was much faster than before!

At this time, the sound of women's shouts and the sounds of zombies fighting could be heard.

This woman is not bad and can persist until now.

There should be a lot of zombies, and this strength should not be underestimated!

When he reached the concave edge, Qin Long slowed down and approached slowly.

In his sight, he finally saw the source of the sound.

Qin Long took a breath of air.

The scene was a bit scary.

The only zombies I expected were a few.
